summary: Frontend-only mobile testing completed for Order Collection V2 payment/shipping flow. Core scroll/layout behavior is working on long payment lists and selection persistence works; however, semantic accessibility state for radio selection is missing in DOM and real-agent integration is blocked by zero real customers (flow tested with read-only GET fixtures).

ui_bugs.issue: Option has role=radio but aria-checked is not rendered in DOM after selection (remains null).
Behavior is blocked correctly (cannot advance), but semantic disabled state is not exposed to web automation via disabled/aria-disabled; button appears actionable in DOM checks.

integration_issues.flow: Authenticated real-data path to Step 3 (Agent account)
integration_issues.issue: Real account loaded 0 customers; payment step could not be reached with real customer data. To validate requested payment/shipping scenarios without DB writes, read-only GET fixtures were used for customers (and for dedicated long-list/empty-list payment tests).

action_items: Expose selected state for payment options with proper web accessibility attribute (aria-checked=true/false) on order-payment-option-{id}.
Review semantic disabled state exposure for order-next-step in empty-payment scenario (functional block already works).
Provide a non-empty testable customer context for AGENTE in preview (or approved fixture path) to run full real-data integration without fallback fixtures.
critical_code_review_comments: Step 1 and Step 2 interactive controls (customer rows, product add buttons, search inputs) still lack dedicated testIDs, reducing automation robustness.
PaymentMethodStep relies on accessibilityState checked, but resulting web DOM does not expose aria-checked as expected for radio validation.
Console repeatedly shows 406 during first-order check path; likely non-blocking but should be handled to avoid noisy diagnostics.
seed_data_creation: No DB seed/writes. TESTS USED READ-ONLY FIXTURE INTERCEPTION ONLY (MOCKED) for customers and for dedicated payment_methods long-list/empty-list scenarios.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed: long payment list (30 fixture methods) scrolls to last option on 320x568 and 390x844; no horizontal overflow; footer navigation remains visible; shipping address field reachable and payment choice persists back-navigation + appears in @order_drafts selectedPaymentId. Real payment methods count observed = 9. Do not test Italia/Estero payment filter in this batch (explicitly blocked by scope).
rca_of_issue: RCA-1: AGENTE account currently returns customers:0 in preview, preventing full real-data progression to payment step. RCA-2: Payment option selected visual state updates (border/icon) but aria-checked is not emitted in web DOM despite role=radio, causing accessibility/test assertion mismatch. RCA-3: Empty list next action is logically blocked in handler/canAdvance (click does not advance) but semantic disabled exposure is weak in web representation.
